x-enumDescriptions.Home: The pool stays with the account: the player's own notes, tags and arrangement. A world on this account's host reads and writes it through the bound owned identity; a projection never carries it.
x-enumDescriptions.Crossing: The pool crosses with the identity: discovered facts, marks, quest progress. A projection carries it to every world the identity enters, and its owner adopts what a colocated traveller carried home.
